title: Senior Manager, Plant Operations
text:
At WK Kellogg Co, we exist to create joy and connection to inspire Gr-r-reat days. We believe that doing good is always good for business and we have stood for this since Kellogg Company was founded more than 120 years ago. We are passionate about doing our part to make nutritious foods, create social connectivity and respect natural resources. Together, these actions create positive progress for people and the planet – today and for years to come. We have big plans for how we are going to accomplish this, and we would love for you to join us in this effort.
 
 
**The most compelling leadership opportunities aren’t always about stepping into something already built. Sometimes they’re about helping shape what comes next.**
The
**Senior Manager, Plant Operations**
leads the strategic and operational direction of multiple business units within a high-performing, large-scale, 24/7 manufacturing operation, and line-centric manufacturing platform.
 
 
This role drives excellence across safety, quality, delivery, cost, and people development by empowering Operations Managers, Supervisors, and fostering a culture of continuous improvement and accountability.
 
 
**You won’t simply inherit an operation. You’ll have the opportunity to help build what comes next.**
**Working Relationships Include**

* Reports to: Plant Director
* Supervises: Operations Managers and Supervisors
* Peer Relationships: KSUM, Quality Manager, Sr. RM Manager, HR Manager, EHS Manager, E& F Manager, KIWS Coach
* Key Contacts: Internal – Plant Leadership Team, Corporate Operations, Engineering, KIWS, HR; External – Vendors, Contractors, and Corporate Support Functions

**Here’s What You Will Be Doing**

* Strategic Leadership: Set direction and priorities for assigned business units, ensuring alignment with plant goals and corporate strategy.
* Team Development: Lead, coach, and develop Operations Managers and Supervisor to build high-performing teams and future leaders.
* Operational Oversight: Ensure consistent execution of production plans and consistently deliver strong results across key plant KPIs, including safety, quality, food safety, cost, and service.
* Innovation & Project Execution: Lead the excellent execution of innovation and projects entering the plant, ensuring effective planning, cross-functional alignment, and successful implementation.
* Budgeting & Planning: Own the business planning and budgeting process for assigned units, including cost containment and resource allocation.
* Lean & CI Deployment: Champion and sustain lean manufacturing principles and WK Kellogg Integrated Work Systems (KIWS) across all units.
* Culture & Engagement: Drive a culture of safety, accountability, and engagement, promoting continuous learning and recognition.
* Compliance & Standards: Ensure compliance with all regulatory and internal standards related to safety, food safety, sanitation, and labor relations.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with support functions and external stakeholders to optimize performance and resolve complex challenges.

**Work Environment**

* This role is based within a 24/7 union manufacturing facility.
* Must be flexible to work any shift and travel up to 25%
* Regular presence on the production floor required
* Frequent interaction with internal teams and external partners

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience required
* 10+ years of progressive leadership experience in manufacturing
* Proven success in leading large teams and managing multiple production lines
* Strong understanding of lean manufacturing and continuous improvement systems
* Demonstrated ability to lead through others and build effective teams
* Excellent strategic thinking, problem-solving, and decision-making skills
* Experience in union environments preferred
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office and SAP
* Experience with budget creation and performance management
* Experience working within a 24/7 manufacturing environment is preferred

***Salary Range:***

*$164,160 - $205,200*
*Salary pay ranges are determined by role and level. Within the range, the successful candidate’s starting base pay will be determined based on factors including job-related skills, experience, certifications, qualifications, relevant education or training, and local market conditions.*
*At WK Kellogg Co, our success depends on our most vital asset — our people. That’s why we’re committed to providing you with benefits and programs that support your Total Health and your journey to be and feel your best — physically, financially, emotionally, and socially.*
*Although subject to change, the below are the benefits currently offered in association with this position:*

* Incentive Plan bonus eligibility
* Health, dental and vision insurance
* Savings and Investment Plan with Company match and contribution
* Paid Time Off (includes paid sick time)
* 11 Paid Holidays
* Life Insurance, AD and D Insurance and STD/LTD
* Tuition reimbursement, adoption assistance for eligible employees
* Employee recognition program

*The above offerings are subject to the terms of WKKC policies, which will control in the event of a conflict with the above descriptions*
*Our comprehensive and competitive benefits not only deliver value to you and your family, but also offer choice to meet your unique needs and knowledge to empower confident decision-making.*
**About Wk Kellogg Co**
*At WK Kellogg Co, we bring our best to everyone, every day through our trusted foods and brands. Our journey began in 1894, when our founder W.K. Kellogg reimagined the future of food with the creation of Corn Flakes, changing breakfast forever. Since then, we have embraced the same spirit of innovation and entrepreneurship in everything we do, channeling our founder’s passion and commitment to creating high quality and delicious products while fostering communities. Our iconic brand portfolio includes Frosted Flakes, Rice Krispies, Froot Loops, Kashi, Special K, Raisin Bran, Frosted Mini Wheats, and Bear Naked. With a presence in the majority of households across North America, our brands play a key role in enhancing the lives of millions of consumers every day, promoting a strong sense of physical, emotional and societal wellbeing. Our beloved brand characters, including Tony the Tiger and Toucan Sam, represent our deep connections with the consumers and communities we serve. For more information, visit*
*www.wkkellogg.com*
